name: Nicolás Vela

hero.h1: I cut the paper. Then I write the code.
hero.sub: From hand-written IE6 fixes to React and TypeScript architecture. Principal Engineer at Capmation today.

colophon.scene: Paper scene cut by hand, rendered in the browser.

hero.lede: Front-end engineer with a formal graphic design background. I build interfaces that are both pixel-perfect and production-grade.

skills.intro: One person, both columns. The bridge is where the work happens.

design.detail: Grids, type scales, color systems, brand application.
Business-process maps turned into sitemaps, flows and wireframes.
Hi-fi screens and component specs before a line of code.
Formal training in advertising design. Identity manuals, editorial illustration, signage.

engineering.detail: Component architecture, state, UI standards across teams.
From AngularJS to modern Angular, Vue 2 and 3.
Node and .NET back ends, WebSockets for live tracking and chat.
Pipelines from zero, Entra ID with role-based access, secrets in Key Vault.
Core Web Vitals budgets, Lighthouse, semantic markup.

bridge: I spec components in Figma with the props they'll have in code.
I map the business process before I draw a screen. The map becomes the state machine.
In 2015 I wrote a utility-first CSS framework so banners couldn't break the brand.

aiNative.title: AI-native
aiNative.line: Daily: GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT. Built with: Azure AI Foundry, Airia, RAG architectures.

highlights: Set front-end standards, CSS architecture and docs used across multiple teams.
Led AI-TimeTracker end to end: Director, PM and designer, then Tech Lead. Team grew from 2 to 5.
Prototyped a compliance platform in Figma, then built it in Angular and .NET.
Led a team of 8 across up to 4 simultaneous projects.
Front-end lead on every major delivery: Aseguradora del Sur, Maresa, PAS HQ.
Turned business-process maps into UX proposals in XD and Sketch before building them.
Took over a team with no lead and no version control. Rolled out Git and JIRA across 10+ projects.
Introduced Scrum and Kanban with WIP limits, plus mandatory standards for contractors. Team of up to 10.
Cut Movistar catalog admin time by 50% with admin-driven Angular catalogs.

experienceBefore.line: Graphic designer, then creative director, then front-end developer and project manager. Print, identity and campaigns first; web products after. Also in 2018: senior full-stack developer at PPM (React systems for Diners Club).

education.note: Thesis: a visual identity manual and its web design.

contact.line: Bring me the sketch. I'll bring it to production.

manifesto.text: I learned composition with scissors and glue in 2003. Twenty years later, the browser is my paper and TypeScript is the blade.
